fields.subject: Mapping Expression Builders
fields.trigger: ExpressionHelpers builds an input simple-value or binary parameter expression for a property via InParameterSimpleBuilder or InParameterBinaryBuilder
fields.response: pass a simple-value property or a byte[] property through to the provider's add-parameter method unmodified; InParameterBinaryBuilder performs no conversion, because the binary map attributes accept only byte[] and reject span and memory types before any builder runs
